BiblicalUsage: Yâtsur means a limb, a part of the body, the structure of a man. Job says his eye is dim with sorrow and all his members are as a shadow.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God sees the body worn thin by grief, and Job's shadow is not hidden from Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
